Your bMail ID is built on an existing email provider. Choose a provider that has partnered with the bMail ISP network.
Your bMail domain will reflect your chosen provider.
Both options carry domain-level identifiability. Your email name is your choice. Leave the name empty in anonymous mode to get a generated number.
Your bMail ID will be: jiyeon.park@bgmail.com
Select a Certification Authority (bCA). They will certify your identity using data they already hold — no new personal data is submitted.
Sent only to the bCA, which returns a signed consent token. Demo records: KT-1002, KB-5001, SKT-2001 (after SKT joins), Shinhan / China Mobile / ICBC hold none.
Your personal data stays at the bCA. Only a signed certificate (not your data) is passed to the bMail ISP.
Register backup communication channels. These are used only to verify you if a recipient reports a phishing attempt from your address. They are never disclosed.
Must be a different address from your bMail ID.
At least one backup channel is required for the verification service to function. Channels are validated annually.
Review your bMail ID registration before submitting.

Request queue
Identification requests are forwarded to the sender for approval. If approved, the ISP requests a certificate from the bCA.
Verification requests involve potentially compromised accounts. Always contact sender via backup channel — never via the flagged email address.

bCA operator portal —
Certify bMail identities using existing subscriber data · Zero-copy policy enforced
Certificate issuance process
1
User applies at bMail ISP
User selects this bCA and grants permission to use subscriber data for certification only (a signed consent token, granted here).
2
ISP sends certification request
Request includes bMail address and permission token. No personal data flows to ISP.
3
bCA verifies via subscriber DB
Identity confirmed against its own records. Pseudonyms allowed — only the domain must be certified.
4
Signed certificate issued
Certificate token returned to ISP. ISP marks the bMail ID as identifiable. Personal data stays at the bCA.
